# Setup

## Libraries

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: true

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: true

datapisum_6 <- read.csv( "../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv")

datafabae_4 <- read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv")

pisum <- datapisum_6 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_pisum = emmean)

fabae <- datafabae_4 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_fabae = emmean)

merged <- inner_join(pisum, fabae, by = "ivip")
```

::: callout-note
The merged dataset contains `r nrow(merged)` IVIPs that were phenotyped for both A. pisum and A. fabae, and for which we have adjusted mean fecundity scores for both aphid species.
:::

# Correlation analysis

## Correlation test

```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
```

::: callout-note
Correlation between A. pisum and A. fabae fecundity scores for shared IVIPs is weak.\
- R correlation score is equal to `r round(cor_test$estimate, 3)`.\
- The corresponding p-value is equal to `r round(cor_test$p.value, 3)` (not significant).
:::

## Scatterplot A. pisum vs A. fabae

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5


ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)  +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP",
    x = "Larvae Total Number (A. pisum)",
    y = "Larvae Total Number (A. fabae)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # add r2 value to the plot
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("R = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 3)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
  )

```

# Genetic clusters and fecundity scores

## Import and add the genetic cluster data to the fecundity data for A. pisum and A. fabae.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: true

genetic_cluster <- read.csv("../../../../00.info/02.genetic_structure_jonathan_dijon/faba_bean_ivip_and_genetic_cluster.csv") %>% dplyr::select(ivip, cluster_name) %>%
  # remove NA records
  filter(!is.na(cluster_name))

merged_cluster <- inner_join(merged, genetic_cluster, by = "ivip")

# Ensure cluster_name is a factor
merged_cluster$cluster_name <- as.factor(merged_cluster$cluster_name)



head(merged_cluster)
```

## Scatterplot with genetic cluster info overlaid

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

# Scatter plot
ggplot(merged_cluster, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae, color = cluster_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +  # overall regression line +          # axes start at 0
  labs(
    title = "Fabae vs Pisum Larvae Counts by Cluster",
    x = "Larvae Total Number (Pisum)",
    y = "Larvae Total Number (Fabae)",
    color = "Genetic Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Boxplot of fecundity scores by genetic cluster for A. pisum and A. fabae, and ANOVA test to check for significant differences between clusters.

```{r}

boxplot(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster,
        main = "Box Plot by Cluster (A. pisum)",
        xlab = "Genetic cluster",
        ylab = "Fecundity score",
        las = 2,            # vertical labels
        cex.axis = 0.6)     # smaller axis text


boxplot(larvae_fabae ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster,
        main = "Box Plot by Cluster (A. fabae)",
        xlab = "Genetic cluster",
        ylab = "Fecundity score",
        las = 2,            # vertical labels
        cex.axis = 0.6)     # smaller axis text
```

```{r}
anova_model <- aov(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster)
summary(anova_model)



library(multcomp)
posthoc <- glht(anova_model, linfct = mcp(cluster_name = "Tukey"))
summary(posthoc)



# Assign letters to groups
library(agricolae)
tukey <- TukeyHSD(anova_model)
tukey
hsd <- HSD.test(anova_model, "cluster_name", group = TRUE)
hsd$groups


anova_model <- aov(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster)
summary(anova_model)



library(multcomp)
posthoc <- glht(anova_model, linfct = mcp(cluster_name = "Tukey"))
summary(posthoc)



# Assign letters to groups
library(agricolae)
tukey <- TukeyHSD(anova_model)
tukey
hsd <- HSD.test(anova_model, "cluster_name", group = TRUE)
hsd$groups
```

# The script used for fecundity figure (Figure 1)

```{r}

cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
cor_test

ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("R = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP",
    x = expression("Adjusted mean of fecundity score" ~ italic("(A. pisum)")),
    y = expression("Adjusted mean of fecundity score" ~ italic("(A. fabae)"))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw()



fabae<-read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv", sep = ",")
pisum <- read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv", sep = ",")

ggplot(fabae, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. fabae)",
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


ggplot(pisum, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. fabae)",
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```
